Make sure you save room for dessert!
Aug 2026 • Family
An attractive restaurant that captures one immediately with the pink backdrop and bright colors in an open air setting. A fantastic (mostly) Vietnamese food selection which you can order from the menu or do a walk around to see and choose what you would like prepared, which adds a uniqueness to the dining experience. (There is a vegetarian menus as well. )
The wait staff is attentive and helpful if you have questions about the food. No long wait and your order is served hot when delivered to your table. The veggies and mints are all fresh. 
The price is very reasonable. 
Noted is the customer mix of tourists and locals.
Make sure you save room for dessert!

Unacceptable service!
Jul 2026 • Family
The restaurant is cosy and the food is quite fine, but the service is terrible! My family and I have traveled through Vietnam for 3 weeks and we have never experienced such poor service. 

We chose the restaurant as it looks very cozy and nice from the outside. When we first got a table, we noticed that there was incredibly much noise, but that is how it is. Our waitress understood very little English so we had to order by showing the menu tab. We repeated several times that we wanted dumpings without fish and the waiter nicked. 

The waiting time for the food was very long and got the food/drinks completely shifted, so some had to wait to get their drink for 35 minutes. We never got all our food and what we got was not right. We tried several times to address the staff, but were just answered with a flabet comment and provocative attitude. We end up just canceling the rest, as 1 hour has already passed. When we finally catch up with a leader, he disagrees with our experience and we still have to pay for getting the wrong food!

We may have ended up in the wrong place at the wrong time, but that is absolutely unacceptable!

Ok local food
May 2026 • Couples
Beautiful place and atmosphere but the food was not the best. Fried calamari and scallops where more batter than the actual seafood portion. Vegetables noodles was ok needed lots of flavor to improve. However, the fried shrimp & pork wontons were the good… sad our main seafood dishes were not good. Even the calamari was supposed to have fried rice on the plate and waitress said they don’t have so she said she would bring regular steamed rice. When she brought the plate she didn’t even bring to steamed rice. At that point I just wanted to pay and leave. Waitress was not friendly or helpful yet your bill reflects many local taxes and tips. Hope they improve both staff and food quality because the atmosphere is nice.

Outstanding! Best restaurant of a month in Vietnam
Mar 2026 • Couples
I traveled a month in Vietnam and I was tired of the usual fried food, the usual rolls etc etc .. Here the cuisine is very varied, the menu is endless and I did not expect this accuracy in every dish given the size of the menu.
Instead, every dish was exquisite, refined and with a touch of tradition.
I mean, I really enjoyed it.
The value for money is also adequate. I've eaten in places where I pay twice as much and eat half as much and it's a bit annoying! Here, however, I feel very good.
